engine_name: Decision engine rule catalogue version 1.1 (P3-02, FR3-17, NFR3-17): 23 rules (5 safety, 5 Today steps, 3 plan adjustments, 10 insights) with exact conditions, minimum data, minimum differences, cooldowns, safety checks and message templates; precedence safety > Today step > plan adjustment > insight; insights Premium, at most 3 per rolling 7 days and 1 per night, the same rule not repeated within 28 days (56 for habit praise); the low-mood safety rule R-SAFE-04 suppresses every non-safety insight and adjustment for 7 days, except the safety adjustment R-ADJ-03, which applies to every member with a calorie target and carries the gentle wording T-ADJ-03g during those days (version 1.1, Owner Q68); no AI.
intended_use: Rule-based insights, Today steps, plan adjustments and safety notices for members, run once a night at 02:00 in the member's time zone and on demand after a profile change, a warning-level reading or opening Today. Every message is an owner-approved template in which the engine fills only numbers and dates; no template names a diagnosis or a medicine, none praises kilograms lost, and emails and notifications never carry an insight's text or numbers (NFR3-16, FR3-56 AS-02).
eligibility: Members with health consent and a profile. Safety rules run first for every member, Free and Premium, and always show. Insights and plan adjustments are Premium, except R-ADJ-03 (losing faster than the safe rate), a safety adjustment applied to every member with a calorie target, Free or Premium, never suppressed by R-SAFE-04; a member with an eating-disorder flag gets the raise with no message and no calorie number (version 1.1, Owner Q68). The safety matrix (P3-03) is evaluated before any rule and again at display time; the engine never fires a rule the matrix forbids for that member, and a rule never fires below its minimum data.
sources: ISH 2020 home BP thresholds and the >= 5 mmHg meaningful difference; Stergiou 2021 (home protocol).
NICE CG189 (weight-loss rate, plateaus); Hall 2011; P3-56 for the cap.
AASM/SRS 2015 sleep duration consensus; Grandner MA et al. Sleep 2010 (short sleep and hypertension).
WHO 2020 physical activity guidelines (150-300 min moderate); Chekroud SR et al. Lancet Psychiatry 2018 (activity and mood, dose about 45 min, 3-5 times a week).
Ross R et al. Waist circumference as a vital sign. Nat Rev Endocrinol 2020 (waist vs weight).
SACN 2015 (fibre 30 g); Stage 1 protein tool for protein targets.
ADA Standards of Care 2025 (glucose levels); FR2-38 wording for self-harm response.
limitations: R-SAFE-02 (glucose warning levels) is applied at save time with the safety matrix Part C wording, not nightly; it has no template of its own in the catalogue and no test data there.
R-STEP-01 has a pregnancy wording variant T-STEP-01p ('share it with your midwife') whose text is not written out in the catalogue.
R-STEP-03, R-STEP-05, R-INS-07, R-INS-09 and R-INS-10 have no should-fire / should-not-fire test data in the catalogue.
Deliberately absent: a water-intake rule and any glucose-pattern rule (I-12: no glucose interpretation beyond the warning levels).
An insight already shown is not withdrawn when its data is later edited.

Message wording is drafted jointly with the content session's safety/stage3-messages.md (P3-77); where the two differ, the catalogue's template IDs are the ones the engine uses and the content file is aligned to them before approval.
regulatory_statement: Signed off by the owner as clinical reviewer on 3 November 2026 (D3-43 to D3-48; record Signoff-P3-02-Decision-Engine-Rule-Catalogue.md). General health information, not a diagnosis or a medical device. Frozen: any change needs a new decision and a new version (NFR3-14, NFR3-17).

Version 1: Signed 3 November 2026 ('Approve all, D3-10 = B', in chat with the clinical session). D3-43 the 23 rules and templates as drafted; D3-44 Skip after a low-mood day does not lower the weekly ring that week; D3-45 plateau never lowers calories, offers a logging focus and a meal-plan swap; D3-46 too fast: calorie target raised by 250 kcal automatically, member told, doctor line if the 7-day rule triggered; D3-47 sleep vs BP: >= 5 mmHg systolic difference, >= 14 paired days with >= 4 short (< 6 h) and >= 4 long (>= 7 h) nights, 42-day window; D3-48 run at 02:00 local nightly plus on demand after profile changes and warning-level readings. Quota 3 insights per rolling 7 days, 1 per night, 28-day cooldown (56 for habit praise); R-SAFE-04 suppresses all non-safety insights and adjustments for 7 days. Wording sign-off (every template T-SAFE-01, 01p, 03, 04, 04s; T-STEP-01 to 05; T-ADJ-01 to 03; T-INS-01 to 10; T-GEN-01) is joint with the P3-77 content approval of 3 November 2026.
